brief.goal: Enable a loopback-only native Plan-bound workbench confirmation flow without per-run Codex scope mutation.

allowed_writes: Task, Context Manifest, control-plane and design documentation
runtime authorization policy and Plan-bound validators
forbidden_actions: all real external platform writes and runtime_truth confirmation consumption
std_project/create, resource execution, monitor creation or retry
OAuth refresh, budget or bid mutation
persisting sensitive or raw platform data
validation_plan: workbench conversation, progress, API and interaction smoke
execution grant and Plan-bound concurrency smoke
resource and Create mock full-chain smoke
restart LaunchAgent and read-only inspect the current runtime Case
stop_conditions: a runtime_truth confirmation or platform action would be consumed during implementation
the policy permits non-loopback, historical Job, Plan drift, unconfirmed action or automatic retry
the implementation requires a new database table, View, Gate or Plan type
